coordinates: Source-relative front -Y, rear +Y, right +X and left -X. Read the drawing north arrow for compass orientation; no surveyed azimuth claimed.

feature_evidence.feature: Whole main hall boundary without neighbors or 2016 corridor
feature_evidence.interpretation: One building, not a facade fragment or whole present museum complex.

feature_evidence.feature: Inner-face anchors and independent roof envelope
evidence: P03 A07 2231.22×1502.11 main RF and 209.65 porch projection
feature_evidence.interpretation: Approximate 1:100 model; 4.2 mm wall thickness is graphical interpretation, not an outer-envelope misreading of 1780×1055.

feature_evidence.feature: Curved main irimoya, lower hipped skirt, upper gables and connected porch roof
feature_evidence.interpretation: Continuous independent 3D surfaces; reduced roof courses and simplified copper crest. Not a plain hip pyramid or gable prism.

feature_evidence.feature: Raised base, discrete side decks, four separate front/rear rail-ledges
feature_evidence.interpretation: Open side-deck undercrofts and rail gaps; no continuous wraparound veranda.

feature_evidence.feature: Right-only external stair and shallow blank rear projection
feature_evidence.interpretation: No invented left staircase, rear doorway or rear portico.

feature_evidence.feature: Window groups, panel doors and diamond transoms
feature_evidence.interpretation: Major subdivisions retained; small joinery and exact decorative member counts simplified. Glazing is a solid coloured display proxy, not a reconstructed open interior.
Pale washed-stone imitation-timber walls, grey roofing, dark frame/louver wood, muted glazing, localized copper patina; not calibrated RGB or later repainting.

limits: Interior and invisible structural/foundation details are not reconstructed; the main enclosure and roof volume are closed display proxies.
Chiwen hooks, pendant carving, roof tiles and rails are bounded simplified silhouettes. The long- and short-elevation ornament heights are not fully consistent; not treated as survey precision.
Local slope and neighboring terrain are omitted; the raised base is architectural, not a guessed terrain model.
No source pixels or traced/extracted CAD linework are included.
